profile.headline: Java Backend Developer | Spring Boot | REST APIs | Microservices | AI Integration | SQL | Banking & Payments Domain
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Developer / Architect & Onsite Lead
profile.summary:
Java Backend Developer with experience building scalable applications using Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices architecture within the banking and payments domain.
Strong background in backend system design, database optimization, and API development, with hands-on experience in JPA, Hibernate, and SQL performance tuning.

Currently expanding into AI-driven application development, including integration of LLM-based services, intelligent automation, and data-driven workflows within backend systems.

Key skills:
• Java, Spring Boot, Microservices Architecture  
• REST API Development & Integration  
• JPA, Hibernate, SQL Optimization  
• Distributed Systems & Backend Design  
• AI/LLM Integration (learning & applying)  
• Banking & Payment Processing Systems  

Focused on building high-performance backend systems and exploring how AI can enhance automation, decision-making, and user experience.
Open to opportunities in:
Java Backend Development | Backend Engineering | AI-enabled Applications

positions.title: Senior Software Developer / Architect & Onsite Lead
positions.description: Served as a Senior Software Developer / Architect and Onsite Lead on IEEE’s NextGen Banking Central (NGBC), a financial management platform supporting organizational units and conferences worldwide. The system streamlined online check payments, managed concentration banking accounts, and provided debit card support for business expenses—helping volunteers and staff simplify financial processes and improve transparency.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Boot · AWS Lambda · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · MySQL · API Gateways

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Served as a Senior Software Developer and Onsite Lead on BNY’s client onboarding project, enhancing the NetX360 and Wove applications used to process diverse client account types. Designed and delivered backend microservices to streamline onboarding workflows, enforce compliance rules, and coordinated with stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution.

positions.title: Sr Software Developer / Onsite Lead - R&D
positions.description: Data Virtualization system is to collect various database information from various teams and build a VDB in the Data Virtualization Platform and deliver it in the form of ODBC, JDBC, REST, or ODATA. The web application Data as a Service (DaaS) is a catalog built on top of VDB to provide business users and application developers searching and browsing capability of all VDB’s available in the Data Virtualization platform in a business-friendly manner for self-service exploration and initiating request to access those VDB’s.  The Data Virtualization system is a collection of JBOSS and DaaS catalog where JBOSS enables agile data utilization by providing data accessibility functionality

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: The purpose of the Enrollment Dashboard allows users to leverage historical data from Otsuka clinical trials to describe (unique) site performance in previous studies. The enrollment dashboard will allow users to customize (add/remove) enrollment criteria from the available enrollment variables in the data specified above. The enrollment dashboard will provide a series of previously defined end-user metrics for the selected enrollment criteria and site selection. These metrics will be displayed on the dashboard and will allow site-specific, and global views of the defined metrics. The enrollment dashboard will provide the necessary expressions and algorithms for simulating the selected enrollment strategy based on defined (or empirically observed) probability distributions of selected enrollment criteria by site

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Clinical Trial Engineering Platform (ClinTrEP) platform is a multi-component software tool designed to enable technical simulated data from every aspect of the clinical trial process to be integrated with a seamless workflow. Users will be able to operate within their native environments and applications, while still providing the relevant information to the overall workflow.
•	The platform will be able to fully integrate with existing Otsuka data sources.
•	The platform will support multiple projects and collaboration across projects for users associated with multiple projects.
•	The platform will support single-sign on (SSO) and integrate with Otsuka directories.
•	The platform data layer will employ big data architecture to store and move data where appropriate and wherever possible as integrations with the defined applications allow.
•	Translating functional requirements into a detailed architecture and design using Java Spring framework.
•	Understanding of the waterfall and agile software development methodologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Electronic Fare System allows you to choose the most convenient way to pay your fare when boarding the bus or train. We are building a new, state-of-the-art electronic fare system that will make it faster, easier and more convenient to ride the bus or train

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Dashboard allows you to navigate through payment details, view the collection management module, and access refund summaries all from one convenient area within the eClinicalWorks Electronic Health Records (EHR). The RCM Console provides you with the ability to filter claims which enhances visibility into your practice. RCM Dashboard has quick account receivable Centralized work queue, Six levels of clearinghouse integration

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: eManager for supporting Comprehensive Electronic Health Records (EHR) Solution. Software for managing Support Tickets (Cases) and efficiency evaluation of team leads and tech support in resolving Tickets (Cases). Remote management of client’s server and product installation server. Report generation and management for client support through web portal – eManager.

positions.title: Software Developer in Java
positions.description: Billeo Enables Financial Institutions & Online Marketplaces to Offer Customers "Buy Now, Pay Now" Options. Billeo's shopping and card bill pay services enhance its customers' existing e-commerce apps, to drive more transactions through shopping purchases or bill payments.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
MediKingD is a special purpose micro-ERP created exclusively for Pharmaceutical Distributors which smoothly handles all your operations related to Purchase, Sales, Inventory, Accounts and Operational MIS. It is EDI-enabled and Net-compatible. It lets your business plug into any electronic supply chain and implement CRM operations.
MediKingD WebExtension is a reporting system created for Medical Representative Data for Medical Representative will be exported month by month so that Medical Representative can view their reports online.

projects.title: Medical Dealer System
projects.description:
Programming Language – Java (Swing), JDerby
Description –
»	This application is made for Medical Distributers, Chemists.
»	In this application user can enter the Purchase details, make the Sales Bills, stores the clients’ cheque details etc. User can also transfer the products from one branch to another branch. User can also store the daily expense. 
»	User can check the account details in this application like Dr/Cr details of client, monthly purchase details, and monthly sales details.
»	User can make so many different reports for sales, purchase. User can also check the previous year details using this application.
